title: The Monstrous Creation
description:
Name: [The Netherite Monstrosity](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/photos/netherite_monstrosity.png:150:150)
Known Locations: The Nether
Estimated Size: Huge
Behavior: When close, The Netherite Monstrosity may slam its arms on the ground, sometimes creating shockwaves disrupting nearby blocks. When at a distance, it may charge at the opponent. At long range, The Netherite Monstrosity can perform various attacks. One of these is spraying out several lava bombs from its mouth, which turn into lava upon hitting the ground. The Netherite Monstrosity can then absorb any nearby lava to heal itself. In addition, it can summon flames from the ground and shoot projectiles from its hand.
Danger Level: §8§lDeadly, recommended to have Fire Resistance
